milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the NE corner and observe the scaffolding tower. Target is the center of the scaffolding tower at (8, 1, -8). Max distance 16 allows detection from reasonable range, facing_tolerance 60 ensures the player is looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward the south interior wall and observe the brown carpet patches at (-6, 0, 8). Max distance 16 with facing_tolerance 60 ensures the player can see the carpet.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because this is a build/place task. The pre-existing library has ~76 bookshelves on 3 walls (west, east, north) with the south wall intentionally left open. Setting min_count to 90 requires the player to place ~14+ additional bookshelves to fill the south wall, completing the library. Box encompasses the entire library structure from (-10,1,-10) to (-4,4,-4).

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because this is a build/conceal task. The hidden room exists behind the library but its doorway at (-7, 1-2, -3) is open. The player must seal this doorway with bookshelves (matching the library wall) AND place brown carpet near the entrance to disguise the floor transition. Two rules ensure both concealment actions are performed: (1) doorway sealed with bookshelves, (2) carpet placed to hide floor evidence.
